description: This source file defines a utility class for handling precomputed arrays of exponential values for integer inputs, used internally by the FastMath class in the Apache Commons Math library. It summarizes tabulated data to optimize mathematical computations.

classes.name: FastMathLiteralArrays
classes.description: Utility class containing arrays of tabulated exponential values for integer inputs, used internally by FastMath.

methods.name: EXP_INT_A
methods.description: Array holding exponential evaluated at integer values, split into parts for precision and performance.

methods.name: EXP_INT_B
methods.description: Array holding the second part of the exponential values for integer inputs, complementing EXP_INT_A to reconstruct exp(x).

methods.name: EXP_FRAC_A
methods.description: Array of exponential values over range 0-1, in increments of 2^-10, representing exp(x/1024) = expFracTableA[x] + expFracTableB[x].

methods.name: EXP_FRAC_B
methods.description: Array complementing EXP_FRAC_A for the same range, providing precise fractional exponential values for internal calculations.

methods.name: loadExpIntA
methods.description: Returns a clone of the EXP_INT_A data array containing tabulated exponential evaluated at integer values.

methods.name: loadExpIntB
methods.description: Returns a clone of the EXP_INT_B data array complementing EXP_INT_A for precise exp(x) reconstruction.

methods.name: loadExpFracA
methods.description: Returns a clone of the EXP_FRAC_A array representing fractional exponential values over range 0-1.

methods.name: loadExpFracB
methods.description: Returns a clone of the EXP_FRAC_B array complementing EXP_FRAC_A for fractional exponential calculations.

methods.name: loadLnMant
methods.description: Returns a clone of the LN_MANT array, which contains logarithmic mantissa values.
